note: This metric is not age-standardized, so differences between countries partly reflect differences in their age structure.
title: Share of boys aged 5–14 with an eating disorder
subtitle: Estimated share of boys aged 5–14 who have [an eating disorder](#dod:eating_disorder), whether or not they are diagnosed, based on representative surveys, medical data, and statistical modeling. This only includes anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa. Prevalence is measured as the share experiencing an eating disorder at a given point in time. It does not measure lifetime prevalence.
